spans.s: नर m. 1. A person, बुद्धिमत्सु नराः श्रेष्ठा नरेषु ब्राह्मणाः स्मृताः M.i.96; 2. a man, a male; 3. the pin of a sundial; 4. the supreme spirit; 5. an epithet of a primitive sage; 6. an epithet of Arjuna.
नार (I) m. Water.
नार (II) n. An assemblage of men.
नारा f. pl. Water, M.i.10.
नर-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -देव, -पति, -पाल m. a king, R.iii.42, vii.62, Megh.i.37, R.ii.75.

नर-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -देव, -पति, -पाल m. a king, R.iii.42, vii.62, Megh.i.37, R.ii.75.
नर-अंतक m. death.
नर-अयण m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

नारायण m. 1. Name of an ancient sage, brother and companion of नर q.v.; Ūrvaśī is described as springing from his thigh, ऊरूद्भवा नरसखस्य मुनेः सुरस्त्री (i.e. उर्वशी) Vikr.i.; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu. (The word is thus derived- आपो नारा
इति प्रोक्ता
आपो वै नरसूनवः । ता यदस्यायनं पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः M.i.10).
नर-अश m. a demon, a goblin.
नर-इंद्र m. 1. a king, R.ii.18, iii.33; 2. a curer of poisons, सुनिग्रहा नरेंद्रेण फणींद्रा इव शत्रवः Sis.ii.88 (where the word is used in both the senses).
नर-उत्तम m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
नर-ऋषभ m. the chief of men, a prince.
नर-कपाल m. a man’s skull.
नर-कीलक m. the murderer of a spiritual preceptor.
नर-केशरिन् m. Viṣṇu in his fourth or Narasinha incarnation.
नर-द्विष् m. a demon, a goblin, Bt.xv.94.
नरंधि m. worldly life.
नर-पशु m. a beast-like man, a beast in human form.
नर-पुंगव m. best of men, an excellent man.
नर-मानिका, -मानिनी, -मालिनी f. a woman with a beard, a masculine woman, an amazon.
नर-मानिका, -मानिनी, -मालिनी f. a woman with a beard, a masculine woman, an amazon.
नर-मानिका, -मानिनी, -मालिनी f. a woman with a beard, a masculine woman, an amazon.
नर-मेध m. a human sacrifice.
नर-यंत्र n. sundial.
नर-यान न्।, -रथ म्।, -वाहन न्। n. a vehicle drawn by men.
नर-रथ m. a vehicle drawn by men.
नर-यान न्।, -रथ म्।, -वाहन न्। n. a vehicle drawn by men.
नर-वाहन m. an epithet of Kubera, R.ix.11.
नर-लोक m. 1. the world of men, the earth; 2. mankind.
नर-व्याघ्र, -शार्दूल m. an eminent man.
नर-व्याघ्र, -शार्दूल m. an eminent man.
नर-शृंग n. man’s horn, i.e. an impossibility, a non-entity.
नर-संसर्ग m. human society.
नर-सिंह m. 1. a great warrior; 2. Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation.
नर-स्कंध m. a multitude or body of men.
नर-हरि m. Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation.
नरक (I) m.n. Hell (including several places of torture, generally considered to be twenty-one), M.ii.116.
नरक (II) m. Name of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa.
नारक (I) a. (f. की) Hellish, infernal.
नारक (II) m. 1. an epithet of hell; 2. the infernal regions.
नरक-अंतक, -अरि, -जित् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
नरक-अंतक, -अरि, -जित् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
नरक-अंतक, -अरि, -जित् m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
नरक-आमय m. the soul after death, a ghost, a spirit.
नरक-कुंड n. an abyss in hell where the wicked are tormented.
नरक-स्था f. the Vaitaraṇī river.
नरंग n. The penis.
नरांग m. The penis.
नारंग (I) m. 1. The orange tree; 2. a libertine; 3. a twin.
नारंग (II) n. 1. The fruit of the orange tree; 2. a carrot.
नरी f. A woman.
नारी f. A woman, श्रियो हि कुर्वंति तथैव नार्यो भुजंगकन्या परिसर्पणानि Mrich.iv.
नर्कुटक n. Nose.
नर्त m. Dancing, a dance.
नर्तक m. 1. A dancer; 2. a dancing master; 3. an actor, a mummer; 4. a bard, a herald; 5. an elephant; 6. a peacock.
नर्तकी f. 1. A female dancer, a singing girl, an actress, Kir.x.41, R.xix.14, 19; 2. a female elephant; 3. a peahen.
नर्तन (I) m. A dancer.
नर्तन (II) n. Dancing, a dance.
नर्तन-गृह n. a dancing hall.
नर्तन-शाला f. a dancing hall.
नर्तन-प्रिय m. an epithet of Śiva.
नर्तित a. (f. ता) Danced, made to dance.
नर्तित a. (f. ता) Danced, made to dance.
नर्द् vt. or vi. 1P (pp. नर्दित; pres. नर्दति) 1. To bellow, to roar, to sound, Bt.xv.35, xiv.50; 2. to go, to move.
नर्द a. (f. र्दा) Bellowing, roaring.
नर्द a. (f. र्दा) Bellowing, roaring.
नर्दन n. 1. Roaring, bellowing; 2. celebrating, praising aloud.
नर्दित (I) m. A kind of die or a throw of dice, नर्दितदर्शितमार्गः कटेन विनिपातितो यामि Mrich.ii.
नर्दित (II) n. Sound, roar, bellowing.
नर्मट m. 1. A pot-sherd; 2. the sun.
नर्मठ m. 1. A jester; 2. a rake, a libertine; 3. sport, amusement; 4. coition; 5. the chin.
नर्मन् n. 1. Sport, amusement, diversion, especially amorous sport, R.xix.28; 2. jest, joke, wit, humour.
नर्मन्-कील m. a husband.
नर्मन्-गर्भ (I) a. full of humour, witty.
नर्मन्-गर्भ (II) m. a secret lover.
नर्मन्-द (I) a. delighting, making happy.
नर्मन्-द (II) m. a jester, a boon-companion.
नर्मन्-दा f. name of a river which rises in Vindya mountain and flows ino the gulf of Cambay, R.v.42.
नर्मन्-द्युति (I) a. bright with joy, cheerful, merry.
नर्मन्-द्युति (II) f. enjoyment of a joke.
नर्मन्-सचिव, -सुहृद् m. an associate of the amusements of a prince or man of rank, नृपतेर्नर्मसचिवः सुतादानान्मित्रं भवतु M.M.ii., तां याचेते नरपतेर्नर्मसुहृन्नंदनो नृपमुखेन 1.
नर्मन्-सचिव, -सुहृद् m. an associate of the amusements of a prince or man of rank, नृपतेर्नर्मसचिवः सुतादानान्मित्रं भवतु M.M.ii., तां याचेते नरपतेर्नर्मसुहृन्नंदनो नृपमुखेन 1.
नर्मरा f. 1. A valley; 2. a bellows; 3. an old woman past menstruation.
नारक (I) a. (f. की) Hellish, infernal.
नारकिक m. An inhabitant of hell.
नारकिक m. An inhabitant of hell.
नारकिक m. An inhabitant of hell.
नाराच m. 1. An iron arrow, तत्र नाराचदुर्दुनम् R.iv.41; 2. an arrow in general; 3. a water-elephant.
नाराचिका f. A goldsmith’s scales.
नाराचिका f. A goldsmith’s scales.
नारायण-प्रिय m. an epithet of Śiva.
नारायणी f. 1. An epithet of Lakṣmī, the goddess of wealth; 2. an epithet of the goddess Durgā.
नारिकेर(ल) m. The same as नालिकेर q.v. (Also नाडिकेर and नाडीकेर.)
नारिकेर(ल) m. The same as नालिकेर q.v. (Also नाडिकेर and नाडीकेर.)
नारिकेलि(ली) f. The same as नालिकेर q.v. (Also नाडिकेर and नाडीकेर.)

नारिकेर(ल) m. The same as नालिकेर q.v. (Also नाडिकेर and नाडीकेर.)
नारिकेर(ल) m. The same as नालिकेर q.v. (Also नाडिकेर and नाडीकेर.)
नारी-तरंगक m. a libertine.
नारी-दूषण n. a woman’s vice; (they are- पानं दुर्जनसंसर्गः पत्या च विरहोऽटनम् । सप्नोऽन्यगृहवासश्च नारीणां दूषणानि षट् M.ix.13).
नारी-प्रसंग m. libertinism, lechery.
नारी-रत्न n. a jewel of a woman, an excellent woman.
नार्यंग m. The orange tree.
नृ-अस्थिमालिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
